title: Open Window Contracts per Customer
content:
# Open Window Contracts per Customer

**Care desk guidance — Window Replacement Contracts**

A customer may hold several Window Replacement Contracts contracts over time, but no more than 2 may be open at the same time, where an open contract is one whose status is signed, measured, ordered or installed; closed and cancelled contracts do not count. A new contract may be signed only when the customer's count of open window replacement contracts is below the cap. When the cap is already reached, the additional openings are added to an open contract by change order before its order release, or the new contract waits until an open contract closes. Door contracts are a separate product line and never count toward this cap.

## What the count reads

The count is taken from the customer's own window contract records and their statuses, not from the customer's description of them.

| Status of a window contract | Counts toward the cap of 2 |
|---|---|
| Signed | Yes |
| Measured | Yes |
| Ordered | Yes |
| Installed | Yes |
| Closed | No |
| Cancelled | No |
| Any door contract | Never |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A customer with one installed window contract and one closed window contract has 1 open contract; 1 is below 2, so a new contract may be signed.
- A customer with one measured and one ordered window contract has 2 open contracts; the cap is reached, so no new contract is signed. The additional openings go onto an open contract by change order before that contract's order release, or the new contract waits until an open contract closes.
- A customer with one signed window contract, one cancelled window contract and two door contracts has 1 open window contract; the door contracts and the cancelled contract do not count.
